question: Which of the following sports personalities won the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mariyappan Thangavelu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mariyappan Thangavelu is** a paralympic high jumper.**
 
• **He represents India in the 2016 summer paralympic games held in Rio de Janeiro in the men's high jump T-42 category, winning the gold medal in the finals.**
 
• He is India's** first Paralympic gold medalist since 2004**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ** Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**

 
 
• Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award is given for**​** the **spectacular and most exceptional performance in the sphere of sports for four years, at international levels.**
 
• The frist recipient of the award was **Chess Grandmaster Viswanath Anand.**
 
• It has **a reward of 25 lakhs**.
 
 
 
• The 2020 recipients of the award are as follows;
 
 
• **​Rohit sharma (Cricket)****​**
 
• **Mariyappan Thangavelu (Para-Athletics)**
 
• **Manika Batra (Table Tennis)**
 
• **Vinesh Phogat (Wrestling)**
 
• **Rani Rampal (Hockey)**
